scope: Known public HTML routes, deduplicated by exact URL (case/trailing slash preserved). Static and prior live evidence do not mean a new live check passed.
limits: Sitemap-only routes do not establish the owning repository or current deployment.
Generated blog route inventory does not cover every runtime-created URL.
No archived code or game is executed by this tool.
Static metadata is parsed as HTML; dynamic links, CSS/JS-generated URLs and JavaScript redirects are not evaluated.

provenance.note: Only published HTML is tested. The unreleased ColorMagic draft must not be treated as published or changed.
